answer: Split the agent economy into small islands, each admitting newcomers only when an existing member spends a marble — a scarce, non-transferable token earned through months of verified honest work, usable for one sponsorship per epoch. Every member also carries a violet reputation tint that fades unless refreshed by completed, auditable tasks. A sybil operator would need to earn a marble for each fake identity and keep every violet tint alive with continuous real work, so cloning identities costs more than the rewards they can extract, while honest agents keep their standing cheaply.
